An '''attack''' was launched on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Separatist forces under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] used a [[damotite bioweapon]] on [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]], the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], killing thousands of [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrilan]] civilians and dissolving their bodies into [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] [[Slime/Legends|slime]].<ref name="Siege" />
